items.name: atomus
items.title: Atomus design system
items.description: The whole Atomus 4.0 system for a shadcn project: tokens (light/dark, brand and radius modes, breakpoints), the shadcn/ui theme mapped to Atomus, Inter and Roboto Mono, base styles, and the @stanvision/atomus-react and @stanvision/atomus-tokens packages.
items.docs:
Atomus is installed: tokens, the shadcn/ui theme, fonts and base styles are in your CSS file.
Components: add them as source with `npx shadcn@latest add @atomus/button` (see https://docs.atomus.io/ai/registry/) or import them from "@stanvision/atomus-react" (and import "@stanvision/atomus-react/styles.css" once).
Agents: read https://docs.atomus.io/llms.txt and the rules at https://docs.atomus.io/ai/rules/
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: atomus-tokens
items.title: Atomus tokens
items.description: All Atomus design tokens as CSS custom properties: light and dark themes, the violet brand, sharp and round radius modes, tablet and mobile breakpoints, plus the Figma text-style classes.
items.docs:
Atomus tokens were added to your CSS file (unlayered custom properties on :root), with the Inter and Roboto Mono fonts.
Switch themes with attributes on <html> or any element: data-theme="dark", data-brand="violet", data-radius="round" | "sharp".
Use semantic tokens only, e.g. var(--color-text-primary), var(--spacing-xl), var(--radius-md). Reference: https://docs.atomus.io/code/tokens/
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: atomus-theme
items.title: Atomus theme for shadcn/ui
items.description: Maps the shadcn/ui variables (background, primary, muted, border, ring, sidebar, chart …) to Atomus semantic tokens, so shadcn/ui components follow the Atomus theme, brand and radius modes.
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: website-parts
items.title: Website section parts
items.description: Layout building blocks for the Atomus website sections (Section, Head, Img, logo and brand marks) and the responsive section CSS. Installed with every website section.
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: header-navigation
items.title: Header navigation
items.description: Website section: Header navigation. Logo (links home); Primary links — 4 to 6, sentence case; Secondary action (Log in, tertiary) and primary CTA; Tablet and mobile: links and actions collapse into a menu button (Type = Mobile menu open shows the panel).
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: Website section: Footer. Brand column: logo and one-line pitch; 4 link columns with a bold heading each; Bottom bar: copyright and legal links; Style = Dark sets data-theme="dark" on the footer, so every token flips.
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: hero-section
items.title: Hero section
items.description: Website section: Hero section. Badge or eyebrow (optional); Headline — Web/Display; Supporting text — Web/Body lg, max ~2 lines; Primary + secondary CTA; Product image or screenshot; Split image puts it beside the text, Email capture swaps the CTAs for an email field.
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: features-section
items.title: Features section
items.description: Website section: Features section. Section heading: eyebrow, title, supporting text; 6 features: featured icon, title (Web/Heading xs), one or two lines of text; Grid: 3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile.
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: feature-split-section
items.title: Feature split section
items.description: Website section: Feature split section. Text column: eyebrow, title, supporting text; Checklist — 3 to 5 short benefits; Optional CTA; Image column; Type = Image left mirrors the order. Stacks text-first on tablet and mobile.
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: bento-section
items.title: Bento section
items.description: Website section: Bento section. Section heading; Bento grid of feature cards — one wide and one tall card for rhythm; Each card: icon or image, title, one line of text; 3 columns → 2 → 1.
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: logo-cloud
items.title: Logo cloud
items.description: Website section: Logo cloud. One-line label ("Trusted by …"), Web/Body, tertiary text; 5–6 customer logos in fg-tertiary (one colour); Wraps to 2 columns on mobile.
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: testimonial
items.title: Testimonial
items.description: Website section: Testimonial. Company logo or star rating; Quote — Web/Heading md, centred, max ~3 lines; Author: avatar, name, role and company.
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: testimonials-grid
items.title: Testimonials grid
items.description: Website section: Testimonials grid. Section heading; Testimonial cards: rating, quote (Web/Body), author row; 3 columns → 2 → 1.
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: metrics-section
items.title: Metrics section
items.description: Website section: Metrics section. Brand background (bg-brand-solid) with on-brand text; Short heading and supporting line; 3–4 key numbers: value (Web/Heading xl) and label; 4 → 2 → 1 columns.
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: pricing-card

items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: faq-item

items.description: Website section: FAQ item. Question — Web/Body lg, semibold; Plus icon that turns into × when open; Answer — Web/Body, secondary text; State: Closed · Open; a hairline divider between items.
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: faq-section
items.title: FAQ section

items.title: CTA section

items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: newsletter-section
items.title: Newsletter section

items.name: blog-card

items.name: blog-section

items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: team-member
items.title: Team member

items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: team-section

items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: not-found-section

items.description: Website section: 404 section. Large "404" in brand text; Title and one line of help; Search field; Back and Home actions.
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: blog-post-content

items.name: content-section
items.title: Content section

items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: press-mentions
items.title: Press mentions

items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)

items.name: auth-section
items.title: Auth section

Logo, title and one line of context; Form: email, password, "Remember me" and "Forgot password" row, full-width primary button; Divider and social sign-in; Footer link to the other flow (Sign up / Log in); Desktop adds a brand panel with a testimonial; Type switches between Log in, Sign up, Forgot password and Verification.
items.author: StanVision (https://stan.vision)
